item.title: Vivid Seats $20 Discount for Customers and Miley Cyrus Album Drops 156 Spots
item.description:
Vivid Seats $20 Discount for Customers and Miley Cyrus Album Drops 156 Spots

Vivid Seats rolled out a limited‑time discount for new shoppers, while Miley Cyrus experienced an unprecedented slide on the music charts after a fresh No. 1 debut.

🔔 Promotion

  • Use COS20 for $20 OFF
  • First-time Vivid Seats customers can take $20 off an order of $200 or more with code COS20 at checkout.
  • Offer subject to Vivid Seats terms and conditions.

📉 Chart Drop

  • After scoring her first No. 1 since 2013, the album plummeted 156 spots in its second week on the chart.
  • Miley Cyrus’ Bass Persuades Suffers Biggest Chart Drop Ever After No. 1 Debut.

#VividSeats #MileyCyrus #MusicCharts #Discount

Source: Music City Tickets, Live at St. Luke’s Theatre, New York on Oct 07, 2026 | Consequence Live
